name: @arc/passport-sdk
description: TypeScript client for ArcPassport on Arc testnet. Typed reads (getPassport, resolveBySubject), typed writes (mintSelf, updateMetadata, revoke), and adapter-pluggable through the IERC8004Identity interface. ABIs are in-tree and hand-curated (regenerate with regen-abi.sh from contracts artifacts when the contract changes).
